claims: U.S. citizenship is obtained through birth.
U.S. citizenship is obtained through descent.
U.S. citizenship is obtained through naturalization.
Naturalization requires lawful permanent residency for 3–5 years.
Naturalization requires good moral character.
Naturalization requires English/civics tests.
Applicants file Form N-400 through USCIS.
U.S. citizens have the right to vote in federal elections.
U.S. citizens can travel with a U.S. passport.
U.S. citizens are eligible for federal jobs.
Birthright citizenship (jus soli) is generally granted to anyone born in the U.S.
Descent citizenship (jus sanguinis) is acquired through U.S. citizen parents.
Naturalization is a legal process for foreign-born individuals to become citizens.
Derivative/acquired citizenship often applies to children under 18 with U.S. citizen parents.
Eligibility for naturalization requires applicants to be 18 or older.
Eligibility for naturalization requires applicants to be a Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card holder) for at least 5 years.
Eligibility for naturalization requires applicants married to a U.S. citizen to be a Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card holder) for at least 3 years.
Eligibility for naturalization requires applicants to demonstrate continuous residence in the U.S.
Eligibility for naturalization requires applicants to demonstrate physical presence in the U.S.
Eligibility for naturalization requires applicants to demonstrate good moral character.
Eligibility for naturalization requires applicants to pass an English test (reading, writing, speaking).
Eligibility for naturalization requires applicants to pass a civics test (U.S. history and government).
Eligibility for naturalization requires applicants to take the Oath of Allegiance.
The USCIS Naturalization Eligibility Tool is used to check eligibility for citizenship.
Form N-400 is completed online or by mail.
Filing Form N-400 requires paying fees.
The naturalization process includes a biometrics appointment to provide fingerprints and photos.
The naturalization process includes completing the interview.
The naturalization process includes passing the civics and English tests.
The naturalization process includes receiving a decision and taking the Oath of Allegiance.
Naturalization processing times vary significantly based on the USCIS field office.
Naturalization processing times typically take several months to over a year.
U.S. citizens are eligible for specific law enforcement jobs.
U.S. citizens can bring family members to the U.S. faster.
U.S. citizens have protection from deportation.
